in_marathi.name: Anath
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lordless, Destitute, Beggar
in_marathi.long_meaning: Anath हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Anath is a Sanskrit name derived from the word 'anat' which means 'lordless' or 'destitute'. This name was given to those who were in a state of poverty, sorrow, or beggary. In Hindu mythology, Anath is also the name of a god who represents compassion and selfless giving. He is depicted as a beggar with an empty bowl, symbolizing his infinite capacity to receive and give.
